items.title: Ivanti VPN提权至root
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可滥用DSCache信任缺陷提权至root，已在野利用并控制VPN设备
items.difficulty: 高(需本地访问·利用条件苛刻·需低权限)
items.repro_note: 滥用DSCache配置信任缺陷触发提权至root
items.description: Ivanti Connect Secure 22.8R2.4 mishandles the manner in which the dsinvoked broker trusts DSCache configuration data, leading to privilege escalation to root, as exploited in the wild in October 2026.

items.title: Ivanti VPN可预测标识符上传文件
items.title_zh: Ivanti VPN可预测标识符上传文件
items.summary_zh: 远程认证攻击者可预测路径上传恶意文件，并串联其他漏洞提权控制设备
items.action_zh: 升级Ivanti Connect Secure至最新修复版
items.repro_note: 认证后利用可预测标识符上传文件至已知路径
items.impact_scope: 边界VPN设备，可作攻击链入口
items.description: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

items.title: LXD证书校验缺陷可接管集群
items.title_zh: LXD证书校验缺陷可接管集群
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者用特制证书链冒充受信客户端，完全控制LXD集群与虚机
items.affected: Ubuntu(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 向LXD HTTPS监听发送特制证书链冒充受信客户端
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚机管理面，集群接管风险
items.description: Improper certificate validation in the HTTPS listener in Canonical LXD 4.0.14, 5.0.10, 5.21.8, 6.9 before 4.0.15, 5.0.11, 5.21.9, 6.10.1 allows an unauthenticated attacker to authenticate as any trusted client and gain full access to the cluster and managed virtual machines via a crafted certificate chain.

items.title: Plex OAuth PIN越权绑定令牌
items.title_zh: Plex OAuth PIN越权绑定令牌
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用自有Plex账号完成PIN并绑定令牌，可越权控制目标实例
items.action_zh: 升级Plex修复版本并限制管理接口访问
items.repro_note: 调用/api/plex/oauth/pin并完成PIN绑定攻击者令牌
items.impact_scope: 媒体服务器，账号与实例接管风险
items.description: Anonymous callers can invoke `POST /api/plex/oauth/logout` to clear credentials and disable the integration, or `POST /api/plex/apikey` to persist an attacker-selected key, without a PIN, account or state precondition. `POST /api/plex/oauth/pin` and `GET /api/plex/oauth/pin/<pin_id>/check` additionally allow an attacker who completes a PIN with an attacker-controlled Plex account to bind that account's token to the instance.

items.title: pgAdmin命令注入可执行系统命令
items.title_zh: pgAdmin命令注入可执行系统命令
items.summary_zh: 认证用户执行特制\copy TO PROGRAM语句，可在pgAdmin主机执行系统命令
items.action_zh: 升级pgAdmin并禁用非必要TO PROGRAM
items.repro_note: 认证用户在pgAdmin执行特制\copy(...) TO PROGRAM语句
items.impact_scope: 数据库管理工具，常存高权凭据
items.description: pgAdmin's and psql's view of the quoting then diverged, a closing parenthesis hidden from the check ended the \copy (...) wrapper, and a following TO PROGRAM clause was executed by psql on the pgAdmin host, as the operating-system account running pgAdmin, before the server rejected the statement. This is a bypass of the fix for CVE-2026-17566.

items.title: ThingLinks认证后代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 已认证攻击者可提交服务端编译执行的代码，获取服务器控制权
items.action_zh: 升级ThingLinks并限制代码编译功能权限
items.repro_note: 认证用户向代码执行功能提交恶意代码并触发实例化
items.impact_scope: 企业IoT平台，服务器失陷风险
items.description: ThingLinks is an enterprise IoT platform. Prior to 1.4.0, the `/groovyScriptTest/registerScript` endpoint accepts user-supplied Groovy script content and passes it to an unsandboxed `Groovy compilation and loading` flow. An authenticated attacker can provide code that is compiled and instantiated on the server, resulting in arbitrary server-side code execution. The issue affects the `rule engine`'s Groovy script test/register flow. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.0.

items.title: SMS Alert插件未授权提权
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可利用订单通知缺陷提升权限，接管站点或读取敏感数据
items.action_zh: 升级插件至最新版，无法升级则停用
items.description: Unauthenticated Privilege Escalation in SMS Alert Order Notifications <= 4.0.2 versions.

items.title: Royal Event主题反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 攻击者可构造恶意序列化数据触发对象注入，最终在WordPress站点执行代码
items.action_zh: 升级主题至最新版或停用Royal Event
items.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in ThemeREX Royal Event allows Object Injection. This issue affects Royal Event: from n/a through 2.0.

items.title: FunnelKit未授权反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可触发PHP对象注入，在受影响WordPress站点执行任意代码
items.description: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in FunnelKit Automations <= 3.8.6.1 versions.

items.title: LeadSnap未授权反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者可触发PHP对象注入，在LeadSnap站点执行任意代码或接管
items.action_zh: 升级LeadSnap至最新版或停用插件
items.description: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in LeadSnap <= 1.25 versions.

items.title: HoneySQL DSL构造不当致SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 应用若将不可信输入传入keyword/symbol生成DSL，可被注入SQL窃取或篡改数据
items.action_zh: 升级至2.7.1392以上并参数化查询
items.repro_note: 应用将用户输入传给keyword/symbol生成并执行DSL
items.description: From 2.0.0 until 2.7.1392, applications that pass user input or other arbitrary data into the HoneySQL `DSL` by calling `keyword` or `symbol` on that input can produce SQL strings that facilitate SQL injection when executed unchanged by a `JDBC` driver. The impact depends on the privileges of the database connection executing the generated statement.

items.title: Sentinel Keys HTTP溢出
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者向Sentinel Keys Server发送特制HTTP请求，可触发溢出或越权
items.action_zh: 升级Sentinel Keys Server并限制HTTP访问
items.repro_note: 向Sentinel Keys Server HTTP接口发送特制请求
items.description: Stack-based buffer overflow and missing authorization vulnerability in Thales Sentinel Keys Server on Windows allows Overflow Buffers. Sentinel Keys Server does not check the length of the first field in the HTTP request. An attacker may craft an HTTP request and send it to Sentinel Keys Server. It may lead to remote code execution as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM. This issue affects Sentinel Keys Server: versions lower than 1.3.8.0.
